notes.title: Sun City Episode 2 – UPDATE NEWS
notes.content:
With Episode 2, nothing in Sun City will ever be the same again. The story now follows a path of no return.

Sun City isn’t just an adult-themed game—it aims to offer a powerful narrative and a truly immersive story experience. The support you showed in Episode 1 was beyond anything we could have imagined. Honestly, even we didn’t expect this much love. And that’s exactly why we’re raising the bar even higher now.

With Episode 2, we're determined to create the best game in our category—pushing boundaries with every step. Each new chapter will elevate both the visual quality and the narrative depth, making the Sun City universe truly unforgettable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/8590757bb156ab831660635b162e6b0667f811e4.gif"]

We recently shared a sneak peek of what’s coming in Episode 2. Don’t worry—we’ll keep you updated every step of the way.

Here’s what’s waiting for you in Episode 2:

💥 Brand-new locations (Nightclub, VIP Restaurant)
💥 All current areas in the game are getting revamped
💥 Enhanced animations and cinematic scenes
💥 Impactful choices that shape the story
💥 Status Points system is now active
💥 Both Relationship Points and Status Points will influence your decisions
💥 Your choices affect not just your relationships, but your social standing too
💥 Hidden areas and confrontations with the past begin here
💥 Exclusive character-driven storylines will be featured

💥20 Original Soundtracks

Sun City is now darker, deeper, and far more dangerous. Don’t forget us…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/c4b7e56693356c4e1468025f70f436419aae3d12.gif"]

notes.title: Sun City: The Next‑Gen Character Update Is Coming!
notes.content:
The Sun City universe continues to grow…
And the upcoming update will elevate our characters to a whole new level!

💥 Expressions will be more natural, emotions deeper, and gazes far more meaningful.
Relationships won’t just be felt through words, but through facial expressions as well.

The short preview below is just a glimpse of the new system. 👇

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/f55c0ed1f222351eb99c262805eb533c6028712b.gif"]

These improvements are possible thanks to your feedback and the support you’ve shown the game. Our goal is to strengthen your connection to the story and turn Sun City into a living world.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/1c782615bad9c57e7a0321e58f6178e1243357fb.gif"]

🗣️ Character voice‑overs, gestures, and animations are now more realistic and fine‑tuned for a seamless, immersive experience.
With Episode 2 — and this major update covering Episode 1 — not only will new episodes get upgraded, but Episode 1 will receive a whole new experience too:

Completely revamped voice acting

Lively facial animations

Enhanced scene transitions

🎉 Thank you for your support as this universe continues to grow every day.

Stay tuned — the real story is just beginning. 🌆

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/6d11dcc6f6895b79f5be324c8f108d4bc2ef704e.gif"]
